web.title: Withholding if ABN is not provided - Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# Withholding if ABN is not provided
If a supplier doesn't provide an ABN, you generally withhold the top rate of tax from the payment and pay it to us.

## On this page
If the supplier does **not** provide an ABN and the total payment for goods and services is more than $75 (excluding GST) you generally withhold the top rate of tax from the payment and pay it to us. **Refer to** [Statement by supplier – not quoting an ABN](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/statement-by-supplier-not-quoting-an-abn).

web.title: Statement by a supplier not quoting an ABN - Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# Statement by a supplier not quoting an ABN
## On this page
If a supplier does not provide its ABN, the payer may need to withhold an amount from the payment for that supply – this is referred to as 'no ABN withholding'.

Certain suppliers are not required to quote an ABN to a payer. In these cases, the suppliers can use the form [Statement by a supplier (PDF, 145KB)This link will download a file](https://www.ato.gov.au/api/public/content/0a46cffad58b4b4ab08df3c3db563e42_Statement_by_a_supplier.pdf) to justify the payer not withholding from the payment to the supplier.

## Requirements for quoting an ABN
However, unless one of the above exceptions applies, payers must withhold 47% (from 1 July 2017) from the payment if it is made before an ABN is quoted.

### What payers need to do if they are required to withhold
- withhold 47% (from 1 July 2017) from the payment, unless an exception applies
- complete a [PAYG payment summary – withholding where ABN not quoted](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-payment-summary-withholding-where-abn-not-quoted) (NAT 3283), providing a copy to the supplier at the time of payment or as soon as possible afterwards – suppliers can use the payment summary to claim a credit in their income tax return for the amount withheld
- complete a [PAYG withholding where ABN not quoted – annual report](https://www.ato.gov.au/forms-and-instructions/payg-withholding-where-abn-not-quoted-annual-report) (NAT 3448).

web.title: No ABN Withholding Explained: When Tax Must Be Withheld
web.description:
# No ABN Withholding Explained: When You Must Withhold Tax in Australia
## Do I have to withhold tax if no ABN is provided?
If withholding should have occurred and did not, the ATO looks to the payer for the tax, not the supplier.

## Practical example: supplier without ABN tax withholding
- ABN quoted: No

- $1,034 reported and paid to the ATO
